arrangement.notes: Sparse verses with strong, energetic hooks using boom bap style. Experimental variation on classic boom bap arrangement emphasizing vocal and sample chopping techniques in the hooks and micro chops during verses.

event_markers.label: Hook begins with vocal chops
event_markers.reason: Introduce strong hook with vocal manipulations

event_markers.label: Verse 1 micro chops
event_markers.reason: Sparse verse energy via micro sample chops

sound_intent.style: Boom Bap with experimental sample chopping techniques
sound_intent.energy_profile: Sparse verses with strong, energetic hooks

track_roles.drums: rhythmic foundation with emphasis on sparse verses and strong hooks
track_roles.bass: low-end support with groove aligned to drums
track_roles.chords: subtle harmonic texture mainly present in hooks
track_roles.melody: textural sample chops rather than traditional melodic lines
track_roles.vocal: main hook focus with extensive vocal chops

designer_intent.focus: Create an engaging boom bap arrangement with uplifting energy conveyed through vocal chops and dynamic sample chopping techniques.

presetor_intent.task: Apply presets emphasizing crisp, vintage boom bap drum sounds and clean vocal chops with delay and stutter effects.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate sparse but punchy boom bap drum patterns emphasizing strong hook presence.

bass_generator.brief: Produce complementary basslines that groove with drums, maintaining low activity in verses and build in hooks.

harmony_generator.brief: Add subtle chord textures mainly in hooks and bridge, avoiding overpowering verses.

melody_generator.brief: Incorporate textural sample chops including micro, phrase, reverse, vocal, and stutter chops aligned with arrangement energy.

ai_designer.brief: Design overall arrangement focusing on energy transitions with sparse verses and strong hooks featuring experimental sample chops.

presetor.brief: Select and refine audio presets to enhance boom bap character and highlight sample chopping techniques.

songgps.brief: Manage arrangement transitions and section energy curve for an uplifting boom bap track with experimental variations.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Balance mix for clear separation of drum, vocal chops, and sample layers emphasizing hook impact.
